instruction: Write a complete XDP/eBPF C program that drops IPv4 TCP packets with both SYN (0x02) and FIN (0x01) flags set simultaneously, and passes all other packets. Validate Ethernet, IPv4, and TCP header bounds.
requirements: Check bounds for Ethernet, IPv4, and TCP headers
Pass all valid TCP packets and non-TCP traffic

tests.name: positive_syn_fin_drop
tests.description: TCP with SYN and FIN (flags=0x03) should be dropped

tests.name: positive_syn_fin_ack_drop
tests.description: TCP with SYN, FIN, and ACK (flags=0x13) should be dropped

tests.name: negative_syn_pass
tests.description: Normal TCP SYN packet (flags=0x02) should pass

tests.name: negative_ack_pass
tests.description: Normal TCP ACK packet (flags=0x10) should pass
